sections.text: مقدمة

This 
document outlines the equipment inspection I1, which must be performed on 
an annually bases as indicated Y1 in the above titled block.

This pump transfers the condensate from the hot well of 
condenser to the heaters then to feed tank.

The first draft initiated by 
eng. Mohamed Abd El Azeem, tested by eng. Mohamed Fawzy Agwa at 08 July 2004, revised by EDEPC quality control eng Abouda Elbanna, accepted by general manager eng. Mohamed El Sarrag, 
approved by eng Moneer Mahmoud Al Wakeel; Damietta 3x135MW Combined Cycle PS head sector, and certified by eng. Aly Al Lethy: 
EDEPC inspection and quality control head sector.

احتياطات السلامة

A work permit must be issued 
 and the qualified maintenance staff should be carry the
فئة السلامة المناسبة,

Safety fence (rope) with 
 caution marks surrounding the work area is required
Wear safety helmets, shoes, earplug and gloves pairs.
Isolate the CB of the pump motor.
Disconnect electric terminals of the pump motor.

Isolate the pump mechanically by closing suction and delivery 
 valves.

sections.text: Pump out of Operation
Check the alignment and compare with the setting values.
Check bolts fixation, then re-tight it [if it is needed].

Grease the bearings of the pump. (type of grease is 
 multi-purpose grease).
Change the packing seal between the shaft and the wear ring.
Check the leakage from the glands and flanges and treat it.
Repaint the casing against rust.
